description: Angular component for a QR code widget in the Thingsboard platform, handling QR code text generation and rendering.

classes.name: QrCodeWidgetComponent
classes.description: Angular component class for QR code widget, managing QR code text and rendering.

methods.name: ngOnInit
methods.description: Initializes the widget, setting up the QR code text function if enabled.

methods.name: ngAfterViewInit
methods.description: Sets up the canvas rendering after the view initializes.

methods.name: onDataUpdated
methods.description: Updates QR code text based on new data or data sources.

methods.name: updateQrCodeText
methods.description: Generates and updates the QR code text, triggers canvas update if valid.

methods.name: updateCanvas
methods.description: Renders the QR code onto the canvas element.
